HUMAN SCALE / Body, gesture & creative attention

Labyrinth walking.

Following a designed path as a contemplative or reflective movement practice.

LEXICON / LANGUAGE & MEANING

Names in context.

Labyrinth walking
Recorrido de laberintos

Walking a designed route as a contemplative or symbolic practice.

Labyrinth
Laberinto de recorrido

A designed winding path; many contemplative examples have one route toward a center.

PROVENANCE & INTERPRETATION

A practice,
a setting.

The labyrinth at Chartres Cathedral offers a named Christian pilgrimage context. Other labyrinth traditions have their own designs and meanings; the path and the interpretation should both be identified.

Human scaleEarth
SOURCES & CONTEXT
Chartres Cathedral — The labyrinth ↗
FIELD NOTE / METHOD

Keep a record.

  1. Identify the design, place and any accompanying tradition.
  2. Record the chosen pace and observations along the route.
  3. Write a reflection afterward while retaining the description of the actual walk.
POTPOURRI / PHOTO GUIDE

What to include.

  • Show the overall path or a permitted plan with start and center labeled.
  • Add a short movement record without photographing other visitors without permission.

POTPOURRI / PERSONAL INTERPRETATION

Share a photograph or a record.

A photograph, drawing or dated record can be sent privately for a personal reading. Include the procedure and the question.
